headline: Thirteen degrees under broken cloud.
body: Temperature has lifted to thirteen. A light south-south-west breeze continues at seven kilometres an hour; pressure holds at one thousand twenty-nine and remains steady. Broken cloud has replaced the earlier thick cover, and the paving stays dry under a sun now three hours risen.
